The values present in the CSV files contained in this folder have been extracted from Table II and Figure 3 in the original paper [1] using [PlotDigitizer](https://plotdigitizer.com/app).

[1] F. Z. Guerrouj, S. A. Rodriguez Florez, A. E. Ouardi, M. Abouzahir, and M. Ramzi, “Quantized Object Detection for Real-Time Inference on Embedded GPU Architectures,” International journal of advanced computer science and applications (IJACSA), vol. 16, no. 5, 2025, doi: 10.14569/IJACSA.2025.0160503.
